summary: Use one FastAPI PPT Core and same-codebase generation, isolated render and export workers; add a broker only after measured scaling thresholds.
invariants: Operation control and quality policy remain PPT Core modules, not separate microservices.
PostgreSQL operation, outbox and lease remain durable queue authority initially.
Render and export receive strong process or container isolation.
Next.js provides UI and status only and does not execute Chrome or converters.
forbidden: Mandatory Redis, Kafka or SQS before measured queue thresholds.
Independent control-plane or quality-gate microservices as the initial design.
Duplicating the domain model across worker repositories.
